title: WP-SOL-B: solution-composition schema + matrix artifact + structural controls (badf-solution-design -> IMPLEMENTED)
objective: Advance badf-solution-design DESIGNED -> IMPLEMENTED by giving its central artifact -- the solution-composition matrix -- a machine shape and a structural validator in the canonical gate. Ship schemas/solution-composition.schema.json (one row per requirement: solution_id, requirement_ref, and the specialist ref arrays), a `solution` command in badf_gate.py that validates a composition matrix (mirroring research/assure -- NOT a second validator script, SOL-I12), and the structural controls SOL-C01 (unique solution ids), SOL-C02 (requirement provenance -- every row names a requirement, SOL-I01 structural), SOL-C03 (a composition binds the requirement to at least one specialist artifact). Ship examples/solution-composition.json validated in CI, failing-first tests + mutation, and advance the registry to IMPLEMENTED.
business_value: The composition matrix is the detailed-design equivalent of the G02 RTM -- the artifact that makes cross-artifact coherence checkable. WP-SOL-A froze it as prose; without a schema + validator it cannot bind a requirement to the specialist refs deterministically. This makes the matrix real and structurally enforced (unique ids, requirement provenance, non-empty binding) inside the one canonical gate -- no second validator, no lifecycle change -- so the harder cross-artifact SEAM controls (WP-SOL-C) have a validated substrate to build on.
in_scope: validate_solution_composition + a `solution` subcommand in scripts/badf_gate.py (mirrors research/assure; returns a PASS string, declares no lifecycle result -- SOL-I12)
structural controls: SOL-C01 unique solution_ids; SOL-C02 every row names a requirement_ref (SOL-I01); SOL-C03 a row binds >=1 specialist artifact
tests/test_badf_solution_composition.py (failing-first) + mutation; registry badf-solution-design DESIGNED -> IMPLEMENTED
GITHUB_CONTROL_PLANE.md doctrine section; own G07 self-dossier
out_of_scope: the cross-artifact SEAM controls (SOL-I01..I12 reconciled against the specialist artifacts) -- WP-SOL-C (VALIDATED, failing-first)
scripts/badf_solution_design.py or any second validator/gate (SOL-I12); a lifecycle.json change / a new G03/G04 required_evidence type (the matrix is a standalone record like research/assure)
specialist adapters (ux/rbac/data/api/accessibility); a global SOL-NNNN lifecycle id family; advancing past IMPLEMENTED
the measured-gate ADR (deferred); BARCHI-2's badf-git GIT-B/GIT-C
acceptance_criteria: examples/solution-composition.json validates via `python3 scripts/badf_gate.py solution <path>` (BADF SOLUTION-COMPOSITION PASS)
a duplicate solution_id, a row with no requirement_ref, and a row that binds no specialist artifact are each refused (SOL-C01/C02/C03)
